title: TabbyChat
description: This Minecraft mod adds tabs to your chat, organising all your messages!
body:
# TabbyChat

TabbyChat is a Minecraft mod that adds tabs to your Minecraft chat!

## What's this mod used for exactly?

The mod comes built-in with two modules which can be enabled:
- The Discord module
  - Adds a tab which links to a Discord channel, powered by a Discord bot
- The Staff Chat module
  - Adds a tab which redirects messages beginning with a configurable staff chat prefix (The messages show without the prefix) and when messages are sent in the tab, this will send via a configurable command or chat message!
